name: Valheim
description: Valheim dedicated server with a small web panel for status, start/stop, SteamCMD updates and server settings.

notes.text: The panel access token is generated during install and stored in /opt/valheim-panel/.env.
A randomly generated server password is written to /etc/valheim/server.env — change it in the panel before inviting players.
8 GB RAM is a realistic minimum for a full 10-player world. The initial SteamCMD download is roughly 2.5 GB.
